### Summary of Sudesh Dahale's Profile

Sudesh Dahale is an Information Technology undergraduate specializing in AI/ML and Natural Language Processing, with notable research in sentiment classification presented at a national conference [3]. He has hands-on internship experience building interactive Tableau dashboards focused on sustainability and business challenges, showcasing strong data visualization skills [1]. Additionally,

Sudesh developed backend systems like an E-commerce Shopping Cart and Flight Booking System using Core Java, emphasizing object-oriented design principles [2]. He co-founded a startup, Induxtron, gaining practical exposure in product development and business execution [2]. Currently maintaining a CGPA of 9.1/10, he is actively building his expertise towards becoming an AI researcher [2][3].
